description: Sets the first game you'll have access to.
This choice will always be included when a specific game is picked.
Choosing any or random will have it pick among the additional games, if there are any, otherwise it will pick among any of the games listed.
Lets you start with some extra items already collected.
Items received depend on the starting game.
